Reach me at [contact@uchidamizuki.com](mailto:contact@uchidamizuki.com).

## Available for

- Talks and seminars
- Training (input–output analysis, regional economic analysis, R and statistics)
- Writing for professional and practitioner journals
- Committee and advisory roles

Useful topics: compiling and using regional input–output tables, common pitfalls in economic ripple-effect analysis, population and employment projection, and statistical methods for evidence-based policy.

For bugs or feature requests in the R packages, please use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/UchidaMizuki) on the relevant repository.
